newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS DULL MONDAY MIXED ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS DULL MONDAY MIXED ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed Monday mixed against hard currencies after a lacklustre interbank foreign exchange session during which the unit hardly shifted from its opening positions.
"Today was a dead market. There was virtually no movement in the rates, probable because there were no payments," one currency dealer said.
"...and maybe the (central) Reserve Bank is happy to see the local dollar at its current levels."
The local unit closed weaker against the key U.S. dollar compared to Friday, finishing half a cent down at 10.8650/8800.
On the crosses, it was quoted firmer against pound sterling at 18.1500/1800 from 18.3120/3400, tracking a stronger U.S. dollar overseas and was at 6.8400/8700 from 6.8860/8990 versus the German mark.
Against the rand of South Africa it registered marginal gains at 2.3200/3400 from 2.3220/3280 at Friday's close.
